sub_sector.value: medical countermeasures vaccines; naloxone opioid overdose nasal spray; contract biomanufacturing

healthcare_segment.detail: Vaccines, antitoxins, immune globulins, naloxone products, plus development and manufacturing services for biopharma.

product_stage.detail: Sells approved products such as NARCAN, CYFENDUS, BioThrax and other licensed countermeasures.

customer_payer.detail: Mainly governments and agencies; also public-sector naloxone buyers, retail channel, and biopharma contract clients.

therapeutic_area.detail: Biodefense threats like anthrax, smallpox, botulism, Ebola; opioid overdose emergency treatment.
